assumption: Teams will document rejected alternatives rather than only final decisions
Leadership can agree on explicit tradeoff rules
Operational teams can translate priorities into action without adding conflicting local goals
Feedback can be routed to ideation strategy or tactics without becoming political blame
Low-alignment initiatives can be paused without major legitimacy loss
Affected stakeholders will have enough context and time to review burdens meaningfully
Decision memory will be used in future reviews rather than archived and ignored
Scenario stress testing will change investment or implementation choices
Teams can distinguish strategic activity from tactical habit
Reframing will reveal options unavailable under the legacy frame
